learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the special secret language of dance and the basic techniques that make every single performance strong and beautiful!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like you learn words to speak English or Hindi, dancers learn a special vocabulary. Terms like Mudra for hand gestures and Chari for leg movements help dancers understand and remember complex steps.
Technique is the safe and proper way a dancer moves their body. Good technique helps a dancer spin faster, jump higher, and balance perfectly without ever getting hurt!

Footwork is the foundation of any great dance. By stomping, tapping, and sliding their feet to a strict rhythm, dancers create amazing sounds and build a strong base for the rest of their body to move.

fun_activity.title: 👣 The Rhythm Tapping Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Sit comfortably and try tapping your right foot two times, then your left foot one time. Repeat this pattern faster and faster to create your very own exciting footwork beat!

quick_recap: ⭐ Learning dance vocabulary helps us easily communicate and remember different steps and gestures.
⭐ Proper technique and strong footwork keep dancers balanced, graceful, and safe on stage.
